description: This file defines auxiliary functions and macros for manipulating prototypes and closures within the Lua virtual machine. It includes macro definitions for calculating sizes and managing upvalues, as well as function declarations for creating and handling Lua function prototypes, closures, and upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_newproto
methods.description: Creates a new Lua function prototype.

methods.name: luaF_newCclosure
methods.description: Creates a new C closure with a specified number of upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_newLclosure
methods.description: Creates a new Lua closure with a specified number of upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_initupvals
methods.description: Initializes upvalues for a given Lua closure.

methods.name: luaF_findupval
methods.description: Finds an existing upvalue or creates a new one at a given stack level.

methods.name: luaF_newtbcupval
methods.description: Creates a new upvalue that is to be closed when no longer needed.

methods.name: luaF_closeupval
methods.description: Closes an open upvalue at a given stack level.

methods.name: luaF_unlinkupval
methods.description: Unlinks an upvalue from the list of open upvalues.

methods.name: luaF_freeproto
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a function prototype.

methods.name: luaF_getlocalname
methods.description: Retrieves the local variable name given a function prototype, local variable number, and program counter.
